description: This file defines the HeaderMapping interface, representing a mapping of headers with source and target keys, including methods for JSON serialization.

classes.name: HeaderMapping
classes.description: An interface defining a header mapping with JSON serialization capabilities, mapping string keys to string values.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the header mapping as a Map of target keys to source values.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the HeaderMapping to a JsonObject using default schema version and field selector.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the HeaderMapping to a JsonObject with specified schema version and field selector.
